question.prompt: The instructions on a \(350\)-gram bag of coffee beans say that proper brewing of a large mug of pour-over coffee requires \(20\) grams of coffee beans. What is the greatest number of properly brewed large mugs of coffee that can be made from the coffee beans in that bag?

solutions.title: Count complete portions
solutions.explanation:
Each properly brewed mug needs a complete \(20\)-gram portion, so divide the available beans into portions of that size:
\[
350=17\cdot20+10.
\]
Thus, \(17\) mugs use \(340\) grams and leave \(10\) grams. That remainder is less than the \(20\) grams needed for another mug. The greatest number is therefore \(\boxed{17}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
